[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Meenan Atraxas''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. Serving as an [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrator]], Atraxas's [[Squad/Legends|squads]] were charged with rescuing [[operative]] [[Klev Natasken]] from [[Koovis]].
